title: Event Emitter

summary: Implement an event emitter with subscribe(eventName, callback) returning an object with unsubscribe(), and emit(eventName, args) returning the callback results in subscription order.
inputFormat: subscribe: string event name and callback; emit: string event name and an argument list.
outputFormat: subscribe returns an object with unsubscribe(); emit returns an array of callback results.
edgeRules: With no subscribers, emit returns an empty array. Unsubscribing removes only that subscription.
